name: Sentence Length Information Entropy
description: Applies Shannon Entropy principles to the distribution curve of sentence lengths across a document. Large Language Models operate on probability maximization, naturally gravitating toward a 'safe, average' sentence length (typically 15-25 words). As a result, AI-generated text produces a narrow, highly predictable, bell-curve distribution of sentence lengths. Human writers are inherently chaotic and rhythmic—effortlessly mixing staccato 3-word sentences for emphasis with sprawling 45-word compound-complex sentences, resulting in a significantly higher and more unpredictable information entropy score.
algorithm: Shannon Entropy Calculation on Sentence Length Frequencies
mechanism: The algorithm tokenizes the text into sentences and counts the word length of each. It groups these lengths into statistical 'bins' (e.g., 1-5 words, 6-10 words, etc.). It then applies the Shannon Entropy formula ($H = -\sum p(x) \log p(x)$) to the probability distribution of these bins. A high entropy score means the sentence lengths are widely and unpredictably distributed (human). A low entropy score indicates that almost all sentences fall into a few predictable length bins, exposing the mathematical homogenization typical of AI generation.
useCase: Best suited for auditing medium-to-long form content (blog posts, articles, academic essays) where there is enough statistical volume to confidently plot a distribution curve of sentence lengths.
strengths:
• Highly robust, language-agnostic metric that relies purely on mathematical distribution rather than analyzing semantics or grammar.
• Very difficult to bypass with simple prompting (e.g., 'write with varied sentence lengths'), as AI models still struggle to mathematically replicate true human entropy.
limitations:
• Entirely ineffective on short texts (under 150 words), as the sample size is too small to calculate a statistically significant entropy curve.
• Highly formalized writing (e.g., legal code, strictly formatted technical specs) naturally produces low entropy and may read as false positives.
parameters:
Analysis: Word Count per Sentence Array
Metric: Shannon Entropy of Length Distribution Bins
Output: 0-100 Entropy Deficit (Mathematical Homogenization) Score
accuracy: High — 82-88% accuracy on texts exceeding 500 words. A foundational pillar of statistical AI detection.
